# vMLX 1.6.77

## Changes

- Batched MLLM: requests with stop strings no longer hang the server (`202d8d0b4`)
- Qwen4 PLE warm: pause for in-flight reads, not for every forward (`43ed9a43a`)
- Media in tool messages reaches the model with a placeholder (`e5a1aa0d9`)
- SimpleEngine plans video frames like the batched engine; image limit is advisory (`7eb644703`)
- GLM-5.3 JANGH2: fused expert-tile + Hadamard-32 prefill on by default (`58a26a396`)
- Naive N0.5: serve long prompts with the padded fused prefill (auto) (`9cf0c2ef8`)
- perf(glm5): memoize full-block checkpoint digests per live cache (`51e061e8a`)
- fix(dflash2): keep rebuilt drafter caches physical under an absolute offset (`d385820ab`)
- perf(glm5): qualify the KDA substitution kernel on MLX 0.32.3, default on (`06b89e614`)
- fix(panel): typewriter snaps to rewritten final content of equal length (`1714fce45`)
- fix(prefill): memory-projection admission advises instead of refusing (`8d17d508e`)
- Honor stop strings completed during final detokenizer flush (`d7fbf6ae8`)
- Recognize DFlash2 as an untranslated technical name (`c0fcb8c64`)
- Correct outdated DFlash2 image acceleration guidance (`59f1319d0`)
- Prepare v1.6.77 runtime and multimodal fixes (`5f007e6d5`)

## Compatibility notes

- Existing 27B DFlash2 disk snapshots are invalidated once by the corrected cache format; subsequent turns rebuild them automatically.
- Projected-memory checks now adapt chunk sizes and issue warnings rather than refuse requests. Actual available memory still determines whether a workload fits.
- GLM KDA acceleration is enabled only on its qualified hardware/runtime path.
